subject: ADR-240: a budget file is the whole budget -- the ethogram's note names all three numbers, the sheet says bout of one and names what it excluded, and the budget CSV carries the out-of-sight row and the event rates
body: The seventh blind trial filed three things on the ethogram and the task certified all three: the budget note called the time in a state 'elapsed' one paragraph under ADR-154's corrected in-no-state note; the budget CSV carried the state rows and nothing else, no out-of-sight row and no event rates; and the sheet said '1 bouts'. The note now names all three numbers (observed, in a state, the session ran), the sheet says bout/bouts and names the excluded and in-no-state time so its lines add up to the clock, and the budget CSV gains an out-of-sight row, one per-observed-minute row per event, and a points-excluded row in point mode. Task 67 to 77 confirmed and refuted on the old page; verify_etho 71 to 86 with a door-driven stepped-clock section stating the durations itself; new mutate_etho 11/11.
